artifact_review:
The Router identified three artifacts. 
1. 'Text gibberish' (Right device): Confirmed by `image_text_auditor` which extracted 'OeDe' with low confidence (0.52). This is a clear AI artifact on the secondary object. Severity 2 is appropriate.
2. 'Texture anomaly' (Click wheel): The `perceptual_quality_auditor` missed this (reported null), but visual inspection confirms the click wheel lacks the physical depth/groove of a real device, appearing as a flat printed circle. This is a subtle structural/texture flaw. Severity 1 is appropriate.
3. 'Perspective distortion/Fusion' (Cable): The `topology_boundary_auditor` gave a high confidence mask (0.99), suggesting the cable and iPod are segmented as a single coherent blob or the boundary is very clean. However, visually, the connector head is indistinct and merges into the port. This is a common AI 'melting' issue. Severity 1 is appropriate, though it could be argued as 2 if the fusion is considered a structural failure of the port. I will stick with 1 as it is minor.
No new catastrophic artifacts were found by experts.
